name: HYDRA-UMC-SERVER
notes: The real headless backend every control client (STUDIO, SUITE, DSI, the mobile apps) actually talks to. It relays bounded authenticated voice turns to a loopback HYDRA-UMC-VOICE-UI gateway while retaining the gateway token server-side (voice never becomes a direct robot command), and now relays the real CM5<->STM32H745 SPI-OTA link to a local spi_bridge service (admin-only for flashing, live progress over WebSocket) - not yet exercised against real STM32H745 hardware, since no populated board exists yet. A new /api/ai/:service/* real passthrough proxy (GET/POST/etc) reaches this cell's own local Hailo-accelerated AI services (cognitive-node/detection-hef/visual-servoing-api/vla-engine, all loopback-only systemd units) the same authenticated way, for a development/control machine that is not on this host itself. New GET /api/adapters and /api/adapters/:adapterId proxy this cell's own real HYDRA-UMC-CONNECTOR-HUB serve-catalog, making this the ecosystem's first real Server-side consumer of the adapter catalog rather than only a CLI/fixture calling its safety gate. src/serverPolicy.ts now holds 8 pure helper functions extracted out of src/server.ts (some previously trapped inside startServer()'s own closure with no external reason to be), each with real, direct node:test unit tests (tests/serverPolicy.test.ts, tests/kinematics.test.ts) run via the already-present tsx devDependency - this repository's first direct unit tests, alongside its existing 11 real end-to-end tools/verify_*_contract.mjs scripts. src/users.ts accounts now carry a real tokenVersion, bumped on every account mutation and re-checked on every authenticated HTTP request and WebSocket tick (not just at login), so deleting/demoting a user or changing its password revokes every already-issued token/session immediately instead of waiting for JWT expiry; users.json reads now distinguish a genuinely missing file from real corruption (throws instead of silently reseeding) and writes are atomic (temp file + rename); scrypt password hashing runs on Node's async threadpool instead of blocking the whole event loop per login, bounded to 4 concurrent operations plus a 20-deep queue with an explicit ScryptOverloadError/503 once both are full (an unbounded queue is just a slower-motion version of the same overload). tests/users.test.ts adds 32 direct unit tests for this store.
